description: This file contains unit tests for the CatalogItemsSpecification class within the application core specifications of the eShopOnWeb project. It tests whether the specification correctly filters catalog items based on given IDs.

classes.name: CatalogItemsSpecification
classes.description: Unit test class for CatalogItemsSpecification, verifying its behavior in filtering catalog items.

methods.name: MatchesSpecificCatalogItem
methods.description: Tests that the specification matches a specific catalog item by ID.

methods.description: Tests that the specification matches all catalog items provided.

methods.description: Creates a sample list of CatalogItem mocks for testing purposes.
